summary: The agent successfully completed the emission-zone-dual-matrix-repair task using the existing edit-embedded-excel skill. Key observations: 1) The fix_cached_values.py --auto mode successfully detected and fixed 12 empty cached values, but missed L12 because it was checking for empty <v /> tags while L12 had <v></v> (different XML representation). 2) The agent had to manually patch L12's cached value in a second pass. 3) The trace shows the agent correctly followed the skill's workflow: parsed slide notes for FINAL vs DRAFT, used label_aliases.csv for abbreviation resolution, used live_matrix_locator.json to identify the live matrix, updated the source cell (I15) not the formula cell (L12), and preserved the archived matrix. The skill's existing guidance on cached value fixing needs enhancement to handle the edge case where the --auto mode doesn't catch all formula cells due to XML representation differences.
